name: remote-control
description: A handheld remote control with two buttons and an open cross pad.
useCase: Choose a remote control or open its device settings.
misuse: Use car-key for vehicle key fobs and gamepad for game controllers.

16.reason: Two buttons remain separate from an open cross pad in a narrow, centered case.

24.reason: The open cross pad has clear space around all four ends and both buttons.
